relations.name: invoice_record
relations.meaning: A billing invoice as represented in authoritative invoice sources with stated id, billed name, amount, currency, period, and payment status.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to exactly one row in sources/billing/invoices.json via invoice_id.
relations.construction_rule: Compile one tuple per invoice object; set invoice join key to invoice_id; preserve all field values as stated in source without canonicalization.

relations.name: contract_record
relations.meaning: A contract file in the data room with source-native identifier, counterparty text as stated, and compiled active versus expired status.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to one sources/contracts/*.md file; active status grounded to explicit term or expiry language in that file.
relations.construction_rule: Emit one tuple per contract markdown file; contract_id is filename without .md; parse counterparty from the Counterparty line; mark active false when source states expiry without renewal (e.g. expired SOW).

relations.name: crm_account_record
relations.meaning: A CRM account row with source-native account id, displayed account name, and CRM status mapped to active boolean.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to one row in sources/crm.csv by crm_account_id.
relations.construction_rule: Compile one tuple per CRM row; account join key is crm_account_id; treat CRM status active as true and churned or inactive as false.

relations.name: registry_entity_record
relations.meaning: A company registry row with source-native company number, legal name, and registry status mapped to active boolean.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to one row in sources/company_registry.csv by company_number.
relations.construction_rule: Compile one tuple per registry row; entity join key is company_number; map registry status active to true and dissolved or inactive to false.

relations.name: contract_clause_kind
relations.meaning: Authoritative contract source text contains contractual language satisfying a named clause kind independent of any diligence analytical threshold.
relations.grounding_contract: ACCEPT requires bounded evidence citing contract source text spans; UNRESOLVED recorded only in obligations when text is ambiguous; do not persist closed-world absence.
relations.construction_rule: For each contract file, evaluate candidate clause kinds against contract text and commercial notes only where notes are treated as authoritative; emit ACCEPT tuples with text grounding.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Cartesian product of each contract_record.contract with the union of purpose A acquisition clause kinds and purpose C obligation kinds from contracts/purpose_a.json and contracts/purpose_c.json allowed_kinds lists.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether the cited contract language substantiates the named clause kind.

relations.name: identity_judgment
relations.meaning: Two commercially relevant identifiers denote the same legal counterparty, are distinct legal entities, or remain unresolved.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded evidence packet per disposition; SAME_ENTITY and DISTINCT require establishing evidence, not mere compatibility or absence of merge.
relations.construction_rule: Resolve candidate identifier pairs under purpose B identifier rendering conventions; forbid global similarity-only merges and undirected transitive closure.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Generate pairs required to connect each CRM account, its billed name, governing contract, and registry candidate legal entities for commercially relevant relationships per purpose B required link set; include mechanical legal_name_form_variant pairs as SAME_ENTITY candidates.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether two records denote the same legal counterparty or are confidently distinct.

relations.name: legal_name_form_variant
relations.meaning: Two registry legal names are deterministic orthographic variants of the same registered form such as Ltd versus Limited.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple derived from registry_entity_record legal_name fields with explicit deterministic normalization rules only.
relations.construction_rule: Derive symmetric pairs within registry rows and between registry legal_name and contract or billing names when the transformation is a fixed legal-form abbreviation table applied to source text.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Pairs of registry_entity_record.legal_name values and between registry legal_name and contract_record.party or invoice_record.billed_name when connected by the same commercial relationship candidate set.

relations.name: invoice_contract_association
relations.meaning: For purpose A exposure reporting, a represented invoice is confidently associated with a governing contract or the linkage remains unresolved.
relations.grounding_contract: asserted requires evidence tying billed revenue to the contract; unresolved explicitly records insufficient linkage without treating absence as non-exposure.
relations.construction_rule: Judge invoice-to-contract linkage using billing, contract counterparty text, CRM, registry identity judgments, and authoritative commercial notes; map SAME_ENTITY-supported joins to asserted where contract governs the billing relationship.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Each invoice_record paired with contract_record candidates sharing a commercially relevant relationship via CRM account, billed name overlap, or authoritative commercial notes.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether the invoice billed revenue is confidently associated with the candidate contract for this diligence question.

relations.name: acquisition_relevant_clause
relations.meaning: A world-compiled clause kind on a contract counts as acquisition-relevant under purpose A analytical policy.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple projects an ACCEPT contract_clause_kind tuple whose clause_kind is in purpose A allowed_kinds; purpose policy label is not world truth.
relations.construction_rule: Select contract_clause_kind tuples with ACCEPT disposition where clause_kind is in contracts/purpose_a.json allowed_kinds; do not re-interpret contract text at this stage.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Filter contract_clause_kind by purpose A allowed_kinds enumeration.

relations.name: commercial_dependency_status
relations.meaning: For purpose C, a counterparty-contract pair is commercially dependent under the two-part purpose test or remains unresolved when required identity linkage is insufficient.
relations.grounding_contract: dependent requires both purpose test parts with confident identity linkage; unresolved when invoice-contract or counterparty identity needed for the join is UNRESOLVED.
relations.construction_rule: Apply purpose C commercial dependence test using open invoice_record rows, active contract_record rows, purpose C obligation clause kinds, and identity_judgment dispositions under purpose B identifier rendering; emit unresolved instead of false when linkage is insufficient.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Each active contract_record paired with counterparty identifiers rendered per purpose B conventions when the contract bears a purpose C obligation kind or has open invoices in the candidate commercial relationship set.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether the counterparty meets the commercial dependence test with confident identity linkage.
